title: Save game progress reset when switching to a new device
symptoms: save progress reset on new phone
Save file not restoring on new device
Player starts from level 1 on new phone
causes: Storing game progress only in local storage (PlayerPrefs/local file) without cloud backup
Missing authentication link to Google Play Games / Apple Game Center

solution.action: Integrate Google Play Games Saved Games and Apple iCloud / Game Center Cloud Save.
Load cloud save data when a user logs in on a new device instead of empty local template.
Use timestamps and checksums to resolve sync conflicts in favor of higher progress.

prevention: Sync local saves to cloud immediately upon critical milestones (level complete, IAP).
